query_normalized: the impact of cognitive load on decision-making accuracy in simulated environments psychology
rationale: This paper satisfies criterion (a) by empirically measuring the impact of cognitive load (operationalized via disclosure complexity and interface difficulty) on decision-making accuracy (grounded accuracy of responses) within a simulated experimental environment. It also meets criterion (b) by providing data on the specific independent variable (cognitive load factors) and dependent variable (accuracy) in a domain (financial decision-making) relevant to the user's psychological inquiry.
